items.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996
items.q: He added so much character to that band... we still try... getting back to that feel

ctx.x: I really loved hearing the chunk-chunk of that acoustic guitar today.

Oh, Freddie, oh, yeah. He added so much character to that band, he really — you know we still try, we have a very good guitarist whom we’ve only had for about, well eight or nine months, and we’re pretty close to getting back to that feel. Because you know we’ve got a bunch of people now you know that play guitar, they usually learn to play electric guitar, solid body guitars that you can’t even hear unless them amplify them through — but this kid is really good. But Freddie, he really, really had this particular…
I’ve always wondered how were the solos spread around in the Basie band? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-
